#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    long long w, m;
    cin >> w >> m;

    if (w <= 3) {
        cout << "YES" << endl;
        return 0;
    }

    const long long limit = 100000000000LL;
    long long a[40];
    a[0] = 1LL;
    long long temp = 1LL;
    int n = 1;

    while (n < 16) {
        temp *= w;
        a[n] = temp;
        if (temp > limit) break;
        n++;
    }

    int total = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) total *= 3;

    bool ok = false;
    for (int mask = 0; mask < total && !ok; mask++) {
        long long left = 0LL;
        long long right = m;
        int code = mask;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int digit = code % 3;
            code /= 3;
            if (digit == 1) left += a[i];
            else if (digit == 2) right += a[i];
        }

        if (left == right) ok = true;
    }

    cout << (ok ? "YES" : "NO") << endl;
    return 0;
}
</translated_code>
